About me

Data Analyst with hands-on project experience turning real-world data into decisions. I have built 20+ machine learning and analytics projects on real datasets — including patient records (Migraine 93.8%, Kidney 100%) and 22 years of Bangladesh rice prices — with reproducible code on GitHub. My journey

How I got from a science classroom in Rajshahi to building machine learning projects on real data.

2022

HSC in Science — Rajshahi City College

Finished my Higher Secondary Certificate under the Rajshahi Board with a GPA of 4.88 out of 5.00. Maths and statistics were always my favourite subjects.

2023

Started BSc in CSE at Southeast University

Began my Computer Science & Engineering degree in Dhaka. Programming clicked early — C, then Python — and I started solving problems on LeetCode alongside my coursework.

2025

Fell for data — Python, SQL & machine learning

Shifted my focus to data: finished certifications in Python for Data Science (IBM), Machine Learning and SQL for Data Science (Coursera) and Data Analysis with Python (freeCodeCamp), and crossed 200+ LeetCode problems.

2026

Built 20+ projects on real data

Turned the skills into finished work — migraine classification at 93.8% accuracy, kidney disease prediction, Dhaka air quality, 22 years of rice prices — and started my final-year research on how generative AI affects students’ creativity and performance.

Featured projects

All of these projects use real data. The number on each card is the result I got, and the chart is from the same project.

Flagship project
Healthcare · Machine Learning

Migraine Classification

My best project. It classifies migraine types from the symptoms of 400 real, physician-diagnosed patients (Hospital Materno Infantil de Soledad, Colombia). I compared three models head to head — and the simplest one won. The full research report goes through ten published papers, takes one idea from each, and fixes each paper’s limitation.

93.8%
Test accuracy
92.2%
5-fold cross-validation
400
Real patients

Model comparison: Logistic Regression 93.8% · Gradient Boosting 92.5% · Random Forest 88.8% — no data augmentation, no leakage tricks.
